tip.zh:
🏠 今日北京阴到多云，气温约 5~12°C，清晨偏凉、体感约 4°C；无雨、风力不大，但空气质量极差（US AQI≈255 / PM2.5≈269，危险级），尽量减少户外久留、出门务必戴口罩，敏感人群建议居家。
🏃 训练提醒：今天周三无固定训练。周四可选跑：预报晴暖（约 5~16°C）但阵风很强（模型日最大风约 16 km/h、阵风约 38 km/h），户外跑请改室内或改日。周五早上健身：约 3~12°C、阵风偏强（约 20 km/h），去健身房途中注意防风保暖；若周五再选户外跑同样建议避开强风。另：周末起气温骤降并有明显降水/雨雪可能，提前调整。

• 11/6 周五 3~12°C 晴到少云，阵风偏强（晨练防风保暖）

tip.en:
🏠 Beijing today: overcast/partly cloudy, ~5–12°C, chilly morning (feels ~4°C); dry with light wind, but hazardous air (US AQI≈255 / PM2.5≈269)—minimize outdoor exposure; mask strongly advised.
🏃 Training: Wed has no fixed session. Thu optional run: milder (~5–16°C) but very strong gusts (~38 km/h)—prefer indoor or another day. Fri morning gym: cooler (~3–12°C) with stronger gusts (~20 km/h)—dress windproof; skip outdoor run if windy. Weekend: sharp cooldown + rain/snow risk.

openingSummary.zh: 过去约两日，GPT/Codex 工程落地与 Claude 侧可验证推理同台：OpenAI 发布「Accelerating engineering for the physical world」，展示 GPT-6 Astra / Codex 助力 CAD、PCB 与仿真，并与赛车/马自达等合作；同日加大 Bug Bounty。Anthropic 开源 FlashProve（zkSNARK 级可验证推理原型，Llama 4 Maverick 约 400B MoE 上单卡 H100 证明吞吐约百 token/s）。@thsottiaux 强调智能体仍处早期、需找回 flow。缺口：@karpathy / Andrew Ng / @claudeai / Google DeepMind / GeminiApp / Meta 关注列表近 48h 无高信号原创帖；无 DeepSeek 一手 X 动态。
openingSummary.en: Over ~48h, GPT/Codex physical-engineering progress and Claude-side verifiable inference led: OpenAI published “Accelerating engineering for the physical world” (GPT-6 Astra/Codex on CAD/PCB/sim; Chip Ganassi / Mazda collabs) and raised bug-bounty rewards. Anthropic open-sourced FlashProve, a zkSNARK-style provable-inference prototype (~100+ tok/s proving on one H100 for ~400B MoE Llama 4 Maverick). @thsottiaux stressed agents are still early and frustrating. Gaps: @karpathy / Andrew Ng / @claudeai / Google DeepMind / GeminiApp / Meta quiet on high-signal originals in ~48h; no DeepSeek primary posts in this watchlist.

summary.zh: OpenAI：ChatGPT 与 Codex 正助力物理世界工程——机械/电气/仿真；团队用 GPT-6 Astra 一周内设计可对话 Codex 的原型设备，并与 Chip Ganassi Racing、马自达等合作验证 CAD/仿真流程。
summary.en: OpenAI: ChatGPT and Codex are accelerating physical-world engineering (mech/EE/sim)—team used GPT-6 Astra to design a Codex-talking prototype device in under a week; collabs include Chip Ganassi Racing and Mazda.

summary.zh: Anthropic 发布 FlashProve：开源可验证推理原型，用密码学证明某回复来自指定模型；可降低劫持对话风险，并让安全评测核对「评测模型=线上模型」。
summary.en: Anthropic introduced FlashProve—an open-source provable-inference prototype using crypto proofs that a response came from a given model; aims to harden chat hijacks and let evaluators verify the served model.

summary.zh: ChatGPT/Codex 产品侧：坦言智能体今日已很强但仍令人沮丧，行业仍很早期；期待继续破局以找回 flow。
summary.en: Codex/ChatGPT product voice: agents today are incredible yet still frustrating—still very early; aiming to crack the loop and get flow state back.

summary.zh: OpenAI 上调 Security Bug Bounty，并引入报告质量/忠诚/优先战役加成；同时规划下一轮内部安全冲刺，与 Cathedral Systems 合作让研究者用自家模型找漏洞。
summary.en: OpenAI raised Security Bug Bounty rewards (quality/loyalty/priority bonuses) and planned the next internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems researchers using OpenAI models.

summary.zh: OpenAIDevs 公开 Pando：为 monorepo 自研 Git 后端，推送延迟约降 80%，日服务近 PB 级 Git 数据，以跟上工程师与智能体用量。
summary.en: OpenAIDevs detailed Pando, a new Git backend for their monorepo—~80% lower push latency, nearly a petabyte of Git data/day—to scale with engineer and agent usage.

caption.zh: OpenAIDevs Pando 视频封面（来源：@OpenAIDevs）

title.zh: 加速物理世界工程：ChatGPT / Codex / Astra 的 CAD·PCB·仿真进展
title.en: Accelerating engineering for the physical world

summary.zh: 11/3：公开机械设计、电气与仿真进展；内部用 Astra 快速迭代硬件，并与赛车/车企合作把 3D 扫描转 CAD、探索仿真设计；强调工程师复核与安全部署。
summary.en: Nov 3: progress across mechanical/EE/simulation—internal Astra hardware iteration plus industry collabs (e.g., 3D-scan→CAD, vehicle design sims); engineers review outputs and guide safe deployment.

title.zh: FlashProve：大模型可验证推理取得进展
title.en: Progress on provable inference for large language models

summary.zh: 11/3 前后：开源 FlashProve（zkSNARK 路线）让提供方提交权重承诺并为回复生成可验证证明；在约 400B MoE（Llama 4 Maverick 4-bit）上报告单卡 H100 证明吞吐约百 token/s、1k token 请求证明约 19MB；附代码与 Lean 形式化。
summary.en: ~Nov 3: open-source FlashProve (zkSNARK-style) lets providers commit to weights and prove responses; reported ~100+ tok/s proving on one H100 for ~400B MoE (Llama 4 Maverick 4-bit) with ~19MB proofs per 1k-token request; code + Lean formalization.

title.zh: 提高 Bug Bounty：以更大奖励支持防御者
title.en: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties

summary.zh: 11/2：上调安全漏洞赏金区间，并加入高质量报告乘数、忠诚加成与优先战役乘数；过去 30 天已发赏金若按新规则更高将补差。
summary.en: Nov 2: higher Security Bug Bounty ranges plus quality/loyalty/priority-campaign multipliers; retroactive top-ups for awards in the past 30 days when the new ranges pay more.

alphaxivTop3.title: Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights
alphaxivTop3.authors: Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang, Omar Khattab (MIT CSAIL)

summary.zh: alphaXiv Hot #1（约 11/2）：报告称 GPT-6 Astra 可直接「读/写」网络权重而无梯度；作者自报编辑 Qwen3.5-0.8B 约 0.016% 权重以打断推理循环并提升数学等能力（作者自报，待独立复核）。
summary.en: alphaXiv Hot #1 (~Nov 2): GPT-6 Astra reportedly inspects/edits raw weights without gradients; authors report editing ~0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B to break reasoning loops and lift math (author-reported).

alphaxivTop3.title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
alphaxivTop3.authors: Xiaoyu Huang, Junlin Yang, Bingxiang He, et al. (Tsinghua / UC Berkeley)

summary.zh: （Agent 优先）Hot #4：uni-robot-agent 开源 harness；作者报告开箱 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 在 RoboDojo 达 31.39，超过已发表 GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe 28.97，并在 19 项真实任务上有竞争力（作者自报）。
summary.en: (Agent pick) Hot #4: uni-robot-agent open harness; authors report out-of-box Qwen3.8-Flash-Next RoboDojo 31.39 vs published GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe 28.97, competitive on 19 real tasks (author-reported).

alphaxivTop3.title: CoworkOS: Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
alphaxivTop3.authors: Guanting Dong, Chengjun Pan, Yutao Zhu, et al. (RUC / FDU)

summary.zh: （Agent 优先）Hot #6：面向真实自动化的 Agent 协作 OS——任务可从模型决策经委派执行回到复核，并保留产物/记录供下一轮决策（作者案例研究；分数提升限于其评测设定）。
summary.en: (Agent pick) Hot #6: an agent-coworker OS for real-world automation—work flows from model decisions through delegated execution back to review, retaining artifacts for the next decision (author case study; gains setup-specific).

summary.zh: 新发 v0.22.7（2026-11-03）：自 v0.22.6 起约 174 个 PR 的补丁汇总（CLI/安装器、微软商店、Docker、Hermes Cloud）；完整整理说明随 v0.23.0。此前同日窗口还有 v0.22.6（11/2，自 v0.22.5 起约 776 PR）。
summary.en: New v0.22.7 (2026-11-03): patch rolling up ~174 PRs since v0.22.6 (CLI/installers, Microsoft Store, Docker, Hermes Cloud); full curated notes with v0.23.0. Same window also saw v0.22.6 (Nov 2, ~776 PRs since v0.22.5).

summary.zh: 新稳定版 v2026.10.10（2026-11-03）：Chat Details 侧栏、实验性 Advisor（任务纠偏建议）、浏览器 Talk 分离语音模式等；约 3028 PR / 454 贡献者。此前预发布停在 v2026.10.10-beta.5（10/30）。
summary.en: New stable v2026.10.10 (2026-11-03): Chat Details panel, experimental Advisor course-corrections, split speech mode for browser Talk; ~3,028 PRs / 454 contributors. Prior prerelease was v2026.10.10-beta.5 (Oct 30).

summary.zh: 实验线新发 dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.3（2026-11-03）：统一右键/键盘菜单、文件预览目录树定位，以及实验性「变更请求与工作树」代码审查入口（把选中代码/评论交给 Agent）。社区预发布最近仍为 dsh-v0.2.1-rc.5（10/30）。关注列表无 DeepSeek 一手 X。
summary.en: Experimental dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.3 (2026-11-03): unified context menus, file-preview tree jump, experimental change-request/worktree review that hands selected code/comments to the Agent. Community pre-release still dsh-v0.2.1-rc.5 (Oct 30). No DeepSeek primary X in watchlist.

summary.zh: 稳定版仍为 rust-v0.166.0 / 0.166.0（2026-10-29）。预发布线推进到 rust-v0.167.0-alpha.4（2026-11-03），说明极简；另有 libcap-v2.75 源码镜像（Bubblewrap/musl 构建用）。尚无新稳定发行说明。
summary.en: Stable still rust-v0.166.0 / 0.166.0 (2026-10-29). Prerelease advanced to rust-v0.167.0-alpha.4 (2026-11-03) with minimal notes; plus libcap-v2.75 source mirror for Bubblewrap/musl builds. No new stable release notes.

summary.zh: 近 48h 无新模型/套餐发布。研究侧 FlashProve 可验证推理已开源（见技术动态）；产品相邻信号仍是 Anthropic Residency（截止 11/22）。新闻室近期锚点：S-1（10/26）、药物研发合作进展（10/27）。模型线无新发（最近 Haiku 5.5，10/7；Opus 5.5 更早）。@claudeai 近两日无原创帖。
summary.en: No new model/plan in ~48h. Research: FlashProve open-sourced (see tech section). Product-adjacent: Anthropic Residency (deadline Nov 22). Newsroom anchors: S-1 (Oct 26), drug-dev progress (Oct 27). No new model (latest Haiku 5.5 on Oct 7; Opus 5.5 earlier). @claudeai quiet on originals.

RSI) and security-baseline prep for incoming security architecture work; ongoing harness-engineering study and daily tech reading; interleaved Guns/Germs/Steel + Dedao course; knowledge-base migration initiative in progress.
